params.prompt:
Photorealistic premium food-comedy commercial, vertical 9:16, energetic editorial rhythm, warm cream and natural kitchen light, realistic faces and anatomically correct hands. The unusual recipe is a transparent bright yellow scalloped ring of savory vegetable gelatin containing celery, green bell pepper and chopped onion, with a central hole; preserve the dish shown in the food reference. No writing, captions, logos, watermarks, app UI, graphic overlays or music: those will be composited later. Natural action sound effects only. Shots must be clear, physical actions, not a slideshow. CHARACTER AND LOCATION: image 1 is the exact lead actor and kitchen. Image 2 is the polished dish identity; image 3 is an archival homemade version used only to guide plausible food construction. Do not place the reference photos as floating images in the scene.
FOUR-SECOND SHARING SHOT: the same adult woman stands in her kitchen behind the finished yellow vegetable gelatin ring on a home plate. She raises her upright black smartphone at chest height with the blank warm-cream display facing the camera. She proudly glances at her dish, taps once on the bottom of the blank screen to share, then looks toward the camera with a satisfied grin. Keep her face in the upper half and the physical dish visible on the counter. Display remains a flat, blank cream rectangle for precise later UI compositing. Keep the phone held reasonably still after the tap, without rotating its screen edge-on. Add one camera shutter and a short sending whoosh. Natural human motion, no digital app interfaces, no typography, no speech or music.
